decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (12/15/WRI/101, 12/15/WRI/102, 12/15/WRI/103 (Existing Elevations), 12/15/WRI/103 (Proposed Elevations), 12/15/WRI/103ROOF, Unnumbered location plan. Received: 19/10/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The three side windows and the side door hereby approved shall be finished in obscure glazing before the development hereby approved is first occupied and the two side dormer windows hereby approved shall be finished in obscure glazing and fixed shut below a level of 1.7 metres above internal finished floor level before the development hereby approved is first occupied. These arrangements shall be permanently retained.
description: Erection of single storey rear infill extension, single storey rear extension and the creation of 2 side dormers at first floor level to the house.
